title: Phone screen that assembles from the lens
summary: An empty phone on flat grey fills itself group by group: header, three action tiles, a section label, five list rows and a tab bar each fall from the camera, big and blurred, onto their slots with overlapping staggers.
use_when: A mobile app whose home screen is a list of items (projects, devices, accounts)
A 5 s silent loop or opener before a feature tour
Showing that an app is set up instantly or that a workspace fills itself
A light, calm product voice where depth comes from motion, not 3D

look.type_style: geometric sans, regular and medium weights, sentence case, small UI sizes: row title ~2.4 % H, muted count line below, section label ~2 % H muted

sfx.event: each list row lands in its slot

structure.shot: empty white rounded phone body, no bezel, centred on flat light grey
status bar and app header (round badge, app name, menu icon) arrive at the top of the phone
structure.motion: header slides down from about 40 px above the phone top, easings.outExpo 12 fr, short settle (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: three outlined action tiles (icon + two-word label each) fill the row under the header
structure.motion: fly-in from the camera: scale ~2.5 -> 1, blur ~10 -> 0 px, opacity ~0.3 -> 1, offset up-right -> 0 on one curve, listSprings.drop 9 fr; stagger 4-5 fr

structure.shot: section label, then five two-line list rows (chevron, 3D icon, name, muted count, more icon); tab bar rises at the bottom
structure.motion: rows fly in from the camera, lower-left vector: scale 2.2-5 -> 1, blur 8-14 -> 0 px (gone 2 fr early), opacity 0.35 -> 1, listSprings.drop lands in 8-10 fr; stagger 3-6 fr (mean 4.5), up to 3 rows in flight; tab bar rises from below at f69, scaleX settle ~3 %, lands 3 fr before the last row

structure.camera: drift 1.00 -> ~1.02 from 3.0 s (motion.json 0.5-1.4 %/s; below sheet resolution)

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the backdrop, fg and muted for row text, accent for the header badge
params.content.tiles: 3 action tiles, icon + label of 2-3 words
params.content.rows: 4-6 list rows: name + short count line + optional icon
params.push: slow push-in during the hold, e.g. [1, 1.04]; 1 = reference (almost static)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Single shot, no cuts, no audio. Numbers from a frame-by-frame human measurement at 30 fps: rows land in 8-10 fr, half the scale distance covered in the first 2 fr, at most 1-2 % settle; stagger 3-6 fr (mean 4.5); one vector per group (header from above, tiles from upper-right, rows from lower-left, tab bar from below); the tab bar closes the frame while rows are still landing. The 2.5 s static hold is the weak part; add a push-in. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed term: camera-drop (element falls from the lens, scale + blur + opacity on one spring); generalises list-assemble enter 'drop' to any UI group.
